scope.objective: Translate primary computational-photography literature and authoritative implementations into bounded Quick, Auto and Max Detail requirements.
scope.interpretationRule: Paper descriptions are not code, model, dataset or patent licences. Every implementation remains disabled until target capability, provenance and resource evidence are verified.

QUICK: Bound frame count and latency before shutter submission
Prefer global tone mapping and conservative detail
Use small-burst alignment only with valid timestamps/confidence
Collapse to the reference frame on any uncertainty
AUTO: Adapt frame count/exposure to motion, noise, thermal and memory budgets
Use robust classical alignment/merge as the baseline
Preserve confidence masks and reference-frame fallback
Do not enable MFSR or learned denoising without measured benefit
MAX_DETAIL: Allow larger RAW bursts only within executable resource policy
Gate MFSR, KPN, gyro and local detail independently
Report longer processing and permit cancellation
Never force invented detail or hide fallback

acceptanceMetrics: Peak memory, latency, thermal rise and cancellation latency
nonClaims: A paper's runtime is not a Galaga benchmark.
A publication does not establish patent clearance or code reuse rights.
A public dataset does not represent the target sensor, optics, ISP or user population.
A learned model does not generalize to Galaga without sensor/noise validation.
Mode assignments are recommendations until executable resource benchmarks replace them.
